headline: Anthropic Builds a Marketplace for Claude Agents
lede: Claude Code’s official plugin catalog turns extensions into a governed system of manifests, skills, and MCP integrations. Stable naming and curated submissions give an expanding agent ecosystem an architectural spine.

headline: A Field Guide for Scientific AI Agents
lede: Scientific Agent Skills gathers 163 validated capabilities across more than 100 scientific databases. Its portable format gives researchers a scholarly index for turning general-purpose agents toward bioinformatics, drug discovery, physics, and geospatial work.

headline: ECC Gives Coding Agents Guardrails and Memory
lede: ECC organizes coding assistants around planning, testing, review, verification, and continuous improvement. Its AgentShield layer audits prompts, hooks, permissions, secrets, and MCP configurations before automation reaches the codebase.

headline: CLI-Anything Puts Desktop Software Under Command
lede: CLI-Anything wraps applications such as Blender, Kdenlive, Obsidian, and Zotero in predictable command-line harnesses. The result is a rugged control surface through which agents can execute tested, repeatable workflows instead of merely describing them.

headline: Context Mode Keeps Agents Focused on the Signal
lede: Context Mode routes bulky tool output through sandboxed execution, returning useful results rather than entire datasets to the model. SQLite, FTS5, and BM25 retrieval preserve the working trail across compaction without flooding the conversation.

headline: Ruflo Orchestrates a Distributed Agent Workforce
lede: Ruflo provides an execution layer for specialized agents, persistent memory, background workers, and vector-backed workflows. Its Rust engine and federated communication layer aim to make autonomous development repeatable across machines and teams.

headline: Android Publishes Skills for Harder Agent Tasks
lede: Android’s skills repository packages focused guidance in modular SKILL.md files for areas where coding agents routinely falter. Developers can install only the instructions they need, bringing official platform practice into the agent’s working surface.

headline: Superpowers Turns Agent Coding Into a Process
lede: Superpowers starts with requirements discovery, validates a design, and then breaks implementation into small, testable tasks. Git worktrees, red-green testing, and explicit review give autonomous coding a documented construction plan.

headline: Cursor Opens Its Agent Plugins to Every Team
lede: Cursor’s plugin catalog connects coding agents to development workflows and business systems through consistent manifests and reusable skills. The same repository can support code review, repository maintenance, CRM lookups, document editing, and coordinated operations.

headline: VoiceStudio Brings 646 Languages On Device
lede: VoiceStudio combines voice cloning, dubbing, audiobook production, and speech recognition in a local desktop pipeline. Its model catalog spans 646 languages while keeping projects and voice data on the user’s hardware.
